batch_title: Studio OS / Tenant Studio / Theme — cinema-grade elevation wave
mission: Take Studio OS, Tenant School Studio, and the theme experience to a whole new level — operator cockpit, day-1 magic, intelligent palette, signature motion. Make it visibly, durably better.
user_directive_2026_05_21: Aggressive push, whole new level — verbatim.
ai_runtime_pin: Cloud-first via LiteLLM (RMC_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE=online). No Ollama on Render. Edge profile = Ollama on LAN hub.

pillars.name: Intelligent Palette System (theme brain)
pillars.vision: Theme builder gains an intelligent palette generator. Operator picks one brand color (or uploads a logo) → AI gateway generates a complete WCAG-AA-compliant 11-stop palette (50/100/200…900) with surface + text + accent variants, dark-mode harmonized, contrast-locked. Brand-from-logo extracts dominant colors via in-process quantization (no external dep). Cloud-first via existing services.ai_helpers boundary.
concrete_deliverables: services/ai_palette.py — generate_palette_from_seed(seed_hex, mode=light|dark|dual) → PaletteResult{stops, surface_chain, text_chain, accent, wcag_grade}
services/theme_intelligence.py — extract_dominant_colors_from_image(bytes) (stdlib + Pillow if available, else honest fallback); harmonize_for_dark(palette_dict); wcag_contrast_ratio(fg_hex, bg_hex)
services/tests/test_ai_palette.py — covers cloud-tier dispatch + rules-fallback + WCAG validation + dark harmonization
services/tests/test_theme_intelligence.py — covers quantization determinism + contrast math + harmonization
apps/siteconfig/views_theme_builder.py — add POST /siteconfig/theme/palette/generate/ endpoint (staff or tenant-scoped) that returns generated palette
templates/siteconfig/theme_builder_control_plane.html + theme_builder.html — wire a 'Generate palette' button + result panel
docs/generated/intelligent_palette_certification.json — proof artifact
binding_constraints: App code imports services.ai_helpers, not services.ai_gateway directly (scan_ai_gateway_boundary baseline 0)
No Ollama-on-Render assumption; cloud tier (litellm) is primary on online profile
WCAG contrast checks must use the standard 4.5:1 (AA normal) / 3:1 (AA large) thresholds
Brand-from-logo runs in-process (no external image-analysis API)
All new CSS uses semantic tokens; no off-token color literals

pillars.name: Studio OS Cockpit + Universal Command Bar
pillars.vision: Studio OS shell upgrades to a 3-region cockpit (signal strip / canvas / co-pilot rail) with a persistent universal command bar (cmd+k) wired across all 4 dashboard shells. Operator can hit cmd+k anywhere and run any major operation: navigate, install pack, generate palette, check health, deploy. Signature motion language unifies transitions.
concrete_deliverables: static/css/studio-os-cockpit.css — 3-region grid with --cockpit-* tokens routed through design-tokens.css
static/css/rmc-signature-motion.css — shared --ease-signature-* + --motion-stage-* tokens; used by cockpit + command bar + day-1 sequence
static/js/rmc-command-bar.js — cmd+k / ctrl+k toggle; keyboard-first; ARIA-compliant combobox; lazy-loads action registry
static/css/rmc-command-bar.css — luxury palette panel; semantic tokens only
templates/partials/rmc_command_bar.html — markup partial; included by base.html + portal_base.html + control_plane_skeleton.html + admin/base_site.html
apps/siteconfig/command_bar_registry.py — Python registry of actions (kind, label, icon, url, scope, role_required); JSON endpoint at /api/command-bar/actions/ returning role-filtered subset
templates/studio_os/shell.html + partials — upgrade to cockpit layout
apps/studio_os/tests/test_command_bar_registry.py + test_cockpit_shell_contract.py
scripts/verify_studio_os_cockpit_contract.py + verify_command_bar_coverage.py — drift gates
docs/generated/studio_os_cockpit_certification.json
binding_constraints: All CSS uses semantic tokens or theme-aware fallbacks (scan_off_token_colors + scan_theme_locked_token_text baseline 0)
Command bar registry is tenant + role scoped (scan_tenant_queryset_safety baseline 0)
No third-party CDN without SRI (scan_sri_required baseline 0)
Command bar JS loads with the armed-attribute pattern from CLAUDE.md (no defer/async)

pillars.name: Tenant School Studio — Day-1 Magic opening sequence
pillars.vision: Tenant operator opens /school/studio/ for the first time → they see a 3-act opening sequence: (Act 1) brand extraction from their school logo + name → (Act 2) AI-generated palette previews across portal+marketing surfaces simultaneously → (Act 3) operator picks one variation + locks. Story-arc onboarding replaces generic dashboard. Subsequent visits show the live cockpit with the operator's branded surfaces.
concrete_deliverables: apps/siteconfig/tenant_studio_day1.py — Day1MagicService that resolves brand seed, calls services.ai_palette.generate_palette_from_seed, builds 3 preview variations, persists choice
apps/siteconfig/views_tenant_studio_hub.py — extend with day1_sequence_view + 3 act endpoints; resume_or_start logic
templates/siteconfig/tenant_studio_hub.html — conditional render of day1 sequence vs cockpit
templates/siteconfig/partials/tenant_studio_day1_act1_brand.html + _act2_palette.html + _act3_lock.html
static/css/tenant-studio-day1.css — choreographed sequence with rmc-signature-motion tokens
static/js/rmc-tenant-studio-day1.js — act transitions, palette preview swap, lock confirmation
apps/siteconfig/tests/test_tenant_studio_day1.py — covers fresh-tenant → day1; returning-tenant → cockpit; partial-progress resume
apps/schools/school_brand_assets.py — extend to accept logo upload + delegate dominant-color extraction to services.theme_intelligence
scripts/verify_tenant_studio_day1_contract.py — assert day1 sequence wired + resume key present + cockpit fallback
docs/generated/tenant_studio_day1_certification.json
binding_constraints: Tenant isolation: brand assets + palette choice live on School / SiteSettings under tenant_id (scan_tenant_queryset_safety baseline 0)
No PII in logger calls during day1 (scan_pii_logging_smell baseline 0)
Logo upload: size + MIME validated; no raw bytes logged
Returning tenants bypass day1 — sequence is one-time-only unless operator opts to re-run
AI palette call honors AI_ALLOW_RULES_FALLBACK setting; degrades to deterministic palette if cloud unreachable
